paper_metadata.title: Structure and high temperature mechanical properties of novel non-equiatomic Fe-(Co, Mn)-Cr-Ni-Al-(Ti) high entropy alloys

evidence.quote: Four non-equiatomic Fe-(Co, Mn)-Cr-Ni-Al-(Ti) high entropy alloys

The alloys with nominal compositions of Fe36Mn21Cr18Ni15Al10, Fe36Co21Cr18Ni15Al10, Fe35Mn20Cr17Ni12Al12Ti4, and Fe35Co20Cr17Ni12Al12Ti4 (the subscripts indicate the atomic percentages (at. %) of the corresponding elements) were produced by vacuum arc melting.

The alloys with nominal compositions of Fe36Mn21Cr18Ni15Al10, Fe36Co21Cr18Ni15Al10, Fe35Mn20Cr17Ni12Al12Ti4, and Fe35Co20Cr17Ni12Al12Ti4 (the subscripts indicate the atomic percentages (at. %) of the corresponding elements) were produced by vacuum arc melting.

The alloys with nominal compositions of Fe36Mn21Cr18Ni15Al10, Fe36Co21Cr18Ni15Al10, Fe35Mn20Cr17Ni12Al12Ti4, and Fe35Co20Cr17Ni12Al12Ti4 (the subscripts indicate the atomic percentages (at. %) of the corresponding elements) were produced by vacuum arc melting.

The alloys with nominal compositions of Fe36Mn21Cr18Ni15Al10, Fe36Co21Cr18Ni15Al10, Fe35Mn20Cr17Ni12Al12Ti4, and Fe35Co20Cr17Ni12Al12Ti4 (the subscripts indicate the atomic percentages (at. %) of the corresponding elements) were produced by vacuum arc melting.
The ingots were remelted 5 times to ensure the chemical homogeneity.

The ingots were remelted 5 times to ensure the chemical homogeneity.

The alloys with nominal compositions of Fe36Mn21Cr18Ni15Al10, Fe36Co21Cr18Ni15Al10, Fe35Mn20Cr17Ni12Al12Ti4, and Fe35Co20Cr17Ni12Al12Ti4 (the subscripts indicate the atomic percentages (at. %) of the corresponding elements) were produced by vacuum arc melting.
The ingots were remelted 5 times to ensure the chemical homogeneity.
the Fe36Mn21Cr18Ni15Al10 alloy was composed of two principal phases –bcc and B2.
The precipitates inside the bcc grains were analyzed using TEM. The average size and fraction of the cuboidal precipitates were 240 nm and 0.38, respectively.
The fraction of the fcc phase was found to be 0.03.
the major phase of the Fe36Co21Cr18Ni15Al10 alloy was the fcc one (a = 3.591 Å).
The volume fractions of both phases were almost identical: 0.03 of the bcc phase and 0.04 of the B2 phase.
The Fe35Mn20Cr17Ni12Al12Ti4 alloy was composed of two major phases: the bcc (a = 2.886 Å) phase and an L21 (ordered fcc) phase (a = 5.832 Å).
The volume fraction of the L21 phase was 0.42.
The fraction of the fcc phase was 0.17.
the fractions of the bcc and L21 phases were 0.44 and 0.39, respectively.

The Fe36Mn21Cr18Ni15Al10 alloy had rather high yield strength of 910 MPa at room temperature
An increase in the testing temperature to 400 °C resulted in a moderate decrease in the yield strength
Further increase of the testing temperature to 600 °C has resulted in a pronounced drop of the yield strength to 325 MPa.
the yield strength of the Fe36Co21Cr18Ni15Al10 alloy at room temperature was only 250 MPa.
An increase in temperature to 400 °C and 600 °C had resulted in some decrease in the yield strength to 155 MPa and 150 MPa, respectively.
